Vasusena Retd. ADDL DCP Hyderabad | Crime Diaries With Muralidhar 735 | iDream News


In this episode of Crime Diaries, former NSG Commando and retired Police Officer Vasu shares an eye-opening breakdown of national security operations, elite commando life, and ground-level policing in Hyderabad.

From how local rowdy sheeters like Golla Kittu, Amberpet Shankar, and Kotha Dasu operated to the legal and operational methods police use to neutralize criminal networks—Officer Vasu breaks down the real challenges faced by law enforcement. He also dives deep into the rigorous selection process for NSG (National Security Guard), the intense daily routine of a Black Cat Commando, the key distinctions between NSG and SPG, and his candid advice for youth aspiring to join the uniform services.

📌 Key Topics Covered:
• Ground realities of handling notorious rowdy sheeters in Secunderabad and Vanasthalipuram
• Step-by-step criteria for opening and maintaining rowdy sheets and invoking the PD Act
• Cracking clue-less burglary cases in Sainikpuri defense colonies
• Daily NSG Commando training schedule: diet, obstacle courses, weapons handling, and endurance
• Key operational differences between NSG (Counter-Terrorism) and SPG (VIP Protection)
• Physical fitness, stamina, mental resilience, and discipline required for Army and Police aspirants
• Frank views on corruption, political influence in postings, and integrity in public service
